retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait on a wooden bench in a soft-focus park setting, featuring stacked white serif typography separated by a decorative rule.
triggerTerms: man sitting on wooden bench in park
warm outdoor portrait with centered text

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in casual attire sits centered on a dark wood church-style bench outdoors. The background is a lush, out-of-focus green park. The lighting is warm and golden, particularly at the bottom edges. White, elegant serif text is overlaid across the man's chest area, featuring a horizontal divider line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally and vertically on a wooden bench
Typography layered directly over the subject's torso
Warm golden light flare at the bottom contrasting with deep green background
Text hierarchy established by scale and a decorative horizontal rule
coreInvariants: Centered wooden bench as the primary prop
White serif typography with a horizontal divider

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body seated portrait, centered, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the bright white text block at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the large display text, then to the subtitle, and finally to the warm light at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant blurred green space above and to the sides of the bench.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep greens and earthy browns in the background and bench.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm golden-orange light flare at the bottom edge.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens, low value in the bench and clothing, high value in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or harsh artificial colors.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform typeface family with varying scale and tracking.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule consisting of a thin line with diagonal hatch marks.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant proportions.
Traditional feel suitable for country/gospel themes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man sitting on a dark wooden park bench, centered, in a lush green park with soft bokeh. Add a warm golden light flare at the bottom of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered white serif text in all caps over the man's chest. The top line should be larger. Separate the lines with a thin horizontal rule featuring a diagonal pattern.

verificationChecks: Is the font a high-contrast serif?
Is there a decorative horizontal rule between the text lines?
Is the background a soft-focus natural environment?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the bottom light flare
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles.
Do not replicate the specific diagonal hatch pattern of the divider exactly.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered.
Check that the serif font has sharp, clear terminals.
Verify the warm light flare does not obscure the subject's feet.
Confirm the horizontal rule is centered between the two lines of text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered subject on rustic prop + soft natural background + stacked wide-tracked serif typography + horizontal divider rule.
